title: Seeking Help in the Digital Age: A Cross-Platform Analysis of Online Support Systems for Technology-Facilitated Abuse Victims
reasoning: The paper evaluates online support systems (including LLMs) on their ability to provide technically accurate and trauma-informed guidance to victims of technology-facilitated abuse. While it measures bias, stereotyping, and victim-blaming, it focuses on trauma-informed care and digital safety rather than benchmarking moral reasoning, formal ethical frameworks, or religious topics.
